title: Main brings a review loop's design change to the user before landing
notes: Retro 2026-11-19: on #329 the review loop replaced the card's rule (merge with no checks only when the repo has no workflows) with a heuristic (sample the last 20 merged PRs), and main landed it reporting only a status line. Add one sentence to main's prompt (src/main/workers/dispatch.ts, the part about worker reports and landing): when a worker's report says the review loop changed what the card asked for, or its design, main asks the user before landing instead of relaying it. Keep it one sentence; a test pins the prompt text if one does today.

comments.body: Pull request #338 opened: Main asks the user before landing a review loop's design change https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/338

Review loop on #338: 2 rounds, ended floor-addressed. Round 1 fixed 4 of 5 findings (c541a47e). The one it rejected, docs/workers/README.md:178 about the land path when merging is on, is out of scope for this PR and stays open as later work. Round 2 fixed 3 low/nit findings (a757a5a8), and no review ran on that commit. No conflict with main. CI passed 5/5 on a757a5a8. Converged, ready to merge.
